name: Yash Kushwaha
tagline: AI/ML Engineer in Progress · Software Engineering Enthusiast
positioning_statement: Building intelligent systems at the intersection of machine learning, software engineering, and real-world problems.
about: I'm a Computer Science student specializing in AI & Machine Learning at Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology (PSIT), Kanpur, currently in my third year. My work sits between applied ML and software engineering: I build systems that go from raw data to a working interface, not just notebooks. Recent work spans exam-preparation tooling powered by LLMs, a sustainability dashboard combining anomaly detection and forecasting, and ML internship work on large-scale predictive modeling. This project — a personal AI agent grounded in my own portfolio data — is part of the same thread: I'm interested in how retrieval, tool use, and grounding turn a language model into something you can actually trust to answer for you.
currently_learning: Currently deepening my understanding of Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM application architecture — this project is part of that hands-on learning.
